fields.Name: T176 - Sort Certifications Grid
fields.Description: Verifies that clicking a column header in the Certifications grid sorts the rows and visibly reorders the grid.

InputDefinition.goal: To open the 'Certifications' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box - type 'Certifications' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Certifications' (NOT 'Certification Types' or 'Certificates'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Once the Certifications grid is loaded, click a visible column header (for example Status or a name column) to sort the grid by that column. Success is reached when the clicked column shows a sort indicator (an ascending or descending arrow) and the row order visibly changes to reflect the sort.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Certifications entity grid is open in the Data Explorer Data section
A visible column header has been clicked and shows a sort indicator (ascending or descending arrow)
The grid row order visibly changes to reflect the applied sort
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
